description: This file defines a UI component named 'Loader' using Lightning Web Components framework. It includes a template for rendering animated circles, props for customization, state management for opacity, lifecycle hooks, and a method to animate the loader.

classes.name: Loader
classes.description: A Lightning component that displays animated circles as a loader indicator.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts an interval to toggle the alpha value of the circles to create a fade-in and fade-out transition.
